factor_name: VIX Shock and Cross-Asset Dispersion Reversal

calculation.expression: -sum_returns(close,3), activated when lagged VIX return is above its rolling 60-day 75th percentile and cross-asset daily dispersion is above its rolling 60-day 75th percentile; cross-sectional median neutralized
calculation.description: A conditional short-term reversal signal that seeks rebound after synchronized volatility and dispersion shocks. All conditioning variables are lagged one day to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Daily results are positive overall; regime split: 2020-22 IC -0.0952 over 12 observations, 2023-24 +0.0894 over 11, 2025-26 +0.1110 over 15, and 2027 +0.2073 over 1. Small active-date sample requires conservative monitoring.
